mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, j.address, j.salary, wa.status, a.* FROM work_assignment wa LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} AND DATE(wa.work_date) = CURRENT_DATE() ORDER BY wa.work_date, wa.time_slot

SELECT wa.id as assignmentId, j.title as jobTitle, j.id as jobId, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, wa.status, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.attendance_status, a.work_minutes FROM work_assignment wa LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY wa.work_date DESC
SELECT id, userId FROM job WHERE id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( work_assignment_id, student_id, check_in_time, is_late, late_minutes, attendance_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workAssignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{checkInTime}, #{isLate}, #{lateMinutes}, 'checked_in', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, attendance_status = 'completed' WHERE work_assignment_id = #{workAssignmentId}
UPDATE work_assignment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{workAssignmentId}
UPDATE attendance SET attendance_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE work_assignment_id = #{workAssignmentId}
UPDATE attendance SET is_late = 0, late_minutes = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE work_assignment_id = #{workAssignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( work_assignment_id, student_id, is_absent, absent_reason, attendance_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workAssignmentId}, #{studentId}, 1, #{reason}, 'absent', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE work_assignment SET merchant_settled = 1, settle_time = #{settleTime}, can_check_out = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{workAssignmentId}
UPDATE attendance SET work_minutes = #{workDurationMinutes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE work_assignment_id = #{workAssignmentId}
